annotations.title: Set where a form's uploads land

description: Choose the destination this form's file uploads go to. Uploads are browser-direct into storage the workspace owns: "gdrive", "box", "s3", "r2", Fillo's short-lived "transit" staging, or "none" to clear the per-form choice and fall back to the project default. The provider must already be connected for the workspace, and a live form that collects files cannot be left without one. Returns the resolved destination. Needs storage:manage.

destination.description: Where uploads land. `transit` and `none` both clear the per-form choice.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.
